description: THE FRONT CARDS (GET /api/front) — the Rokha-native half of the market as one ranked list; for the store itself (aisles, departments, the whole open registry) use market_search. Every published rig, skill, Forge agent, claimed page and marketer on Rokha as a card, ranked by real use (GET /api/front/stats for published, uses_total, uses_24h, live_now, builders, registered_users, calls). Every number is a count of use, never money. Each card: kind, id, title, handle, href, image/avatar, official (Rokha's own), architect (built by Rokha's founder), proven (ran end to end with no step error), uses_total, users_total (all-time — what a card shows; uses_7d + users_7d kept for compatibility), reach.followers, last_active_at, live (used in the last 15 min), new, and cta (Run it / Talk to it / Open) plus cta_secondary (Clone it → the Studio) when the rig can be adopted. Never an owner wallet or a runner identity. `sort` = top (default: most used — uses, then distinct users, then last active) · live · active · new; `kind` = all · rig · skill · agent · page · marketer; `limit` 1–60 (default 24). Cached 60 s. Public, no auth.
